answer: A sybil tax stops bulk forgery at the gate: every new identity pays a non-refundable 5 POA entry fee before it can trade. At the zenith, a forger wanting 1,000 accounts sinks 5,000 POA upfront, while the fake volume could win back at most 4,200 POA. Like a sparrow carrying one grain, an honest agent pays once, trades for months, and earns the fee back within a week. A bought hollow identity gets no refund, so resale cannot dodge the tax.
